about: C45 (PR1 bench, 25/09/2026, benchwp01): 'rename About to Our story, and the menu too'. The model sent the Header menu (wp_navigation post 68) with every block delimiter retyped '} />' for '} /-->'; the body had no '-->' at all, WordPress parsed it to no blocks and the header fell back to another menu, while the length-only check called it verified.
